identity_rule: episode_id = EP_BATCH_<sha256(country, release_ts, member_event_ids, episode_family, session_id)[:20]> for a cluster, otherwise EP_EVENT_<same digest>. It is deterministic; it is never a UUID. session_id remains a container identity and cannot substitute for episode_id.

source_event_consumption.rule: event_id remains unmodified source lineage, but is not accepted as a globally unique key. Consume each Event row through event_record_locator = SHA-256(event_id, batch_id, country, indicator_name, release_ts, source_cal, source_provider, source_series_id, type). Exact duplicate locators collapse to one source observation; the latest released_ts, then Extract Date, then canonical row ordering selects repeated snapshots/revisions. Distinct locators sharing event_id are identity collisions and remain distinct source observations.

grouping_rule.candidate_boundary: country plus release_ts normalized to UTC minute
grouping_rule.cluster_rule: Use a non-empty inherited batch_id only when all member rows share country and UTC release minute and type=member. The resulting Episode is one coherent same-time cluster.
grouping_rule.collision_rule: Different valid batch_id values at the same minute are separate Episodes. Unbatched type=single rows are separate standalone Episodes even at the same minute. Speech, text, report, unresolved, and non-forecastable rows cannot create a multi-event cluster without a valid batch_id; selection may be WATCH, IGNORE, or NO_SIGNAL.

member_roles.CONTEXT_COMPONENT: a retained member used for context only; it never creates a separate immediate outcome window

selection_statuses.WATCH: relevant context without independent scored directional forecast
selection_statuses.IGNORE: not relevant enough for forecast reasoning
selection_statuses.NO_SIGNAL: meaningful Episode with no claimed directional edge

invariants: member_event_ids are non-empty and unique within an Episode
secondary members are distinct non-primary members
same_time_cluster_flag is true exactly when member count exceeds one
